newsitem.title: ITALY: First Italian cities' Sept CPI data out on Sept 23.
newsitem.headline: First Italian cities' Sept CPI data out on Sept 23.

text.p: Preliminary consumer price inflation data for September from Milan and Bologna, the first of the 10 sample Italian cities to report, will be published on September 23, the two cities said.
On Monday September 16 national statistics office ISTAT is due to issue the complete calendar for all the cities' CPI data. ISTAT will issue the final national figures on October 4.
The annual rate of inflation fell in August to 3.4 percent, the lowest for 27 years. This followed a 3.6 percent CPI rise in July and was the seventh successive drop.
